# SmartHomeDeviceDialog

**Class:** `SmartHomeDeviceDialog` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A device's details with its control

## Overview

@brief Device detail dialog A sheet with the device's name and a close button, what it is (category, protocol, state, maker, model, firmware), the control that fits it - a light control for a light, a lock control for a lock - and Rename / Remove. Starts hidden; Show() fills it for a device.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasUIElement> CreateSmartHomeDeviceDialogElement();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
SmartHomeDeviceDialog(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
SmartHomeDeviceDialog(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit SmartHomeDeviceDialog(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetOnClose()` | `void SetOnClose(std::function<void()> callback)` | Visibility is the base class's, deliberately. UltraCanvasUIElement:: IsVisible() is NOT virtual, so declaring one here would only hide it: the dialog would think it was hidden while the framework's dispatch and focus handling - which call the base - carried on as if it were not. Show() and Hide() drive SetVisible(), … |
| `SetOnRename()` | `void SetOnRename(std::function<void(const std::string&)> callback)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetOnRemove()` | `void SetOnRemove(std::function<void()> callback)` | Takes a callback. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
